Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36864: rpc: deprecate iswatchonly field of getaddressinfo

5b2f979c9e474a641b90902c3a87dee93c8f2899 doc: add release note for getaddressinfo iswatchonly deprecation (w0xlt)
375dc869d8bd444f7485ab0c030d793063d91a06 rpc: deprecate iswatchonly field of getaddressinfo (w0xlt)

Pull request description:

  Since #32618, `getaddressinfo` returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address. It was kept and marked "(DEPRECATED)" so it could be removed later without surprising users ([review comment](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32618#discussion_r2180720302)), but it was never put behind `-deprecatedrpc`. The v30 release notes also say it was already removed from all RPCs, which isn't true for `getaddressinfo`.

  This returns it only with `-deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly`, like `startingheight` in `getpeerinfo` (#34197), so it can be removed in the next release.

Pull request description:

  Some wallet functional tests start or restart nodes they never use:

  - `wallet_basic.py`: node 3 hasn't been used since the `resendwallettransactions` check was removed in 2019 (f5162458cd), but the test still starts, stops and restarts it. Without it, the sync calls no longer need `self.nodes[0:3]`.

  - `wallet_sendall.py` restarts node 0 and reloads its wallets twice in a row with the same arguments.

  No coverage changes. Each test runs a bit faster, about 0.2–0.4 s per test locally.

Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36889: cmake: Switch `include_directories` -> `target_include_directories`

435d5b227748a0ac5d6d2887050acf02304576f2 cmake: Remove `WarnAboutGlobalProperties` module (Hennadii Stepanov)
460f877fac200ccfde265d12613b352def903cf0 cmake: Switch `include_directories` -> `target_include_directories` (Hennadii Stepanov)
4ef05d6f45620254417fe6be701bebbf1a42619a cmake: Link `bitcoin_ipc` against `core_interface` (Hennadii Stepanov)

Pull request description:

  Use of non-target directives is not recommended. As of CMake 4.5.0, such use triggers `-Wnon-target-directive` warnings:
  ```console
  $ cmake -B build -Wnon-target-directive
  <snip>
  CMake Warning (non-target-directive) at src/CMakeLists.txt:8 (include_directories):
    Use of non-target directives is not recommended.  Consider
    target_include_directories instead.
  This warning is for project developers.  Use -Wno-author or
  -Wno-non-target-directive to suppress it.

  <snip>
  ```

  This PR:
  1. Links `bitcoin_ipc` against `core_interface`, so that `ipc/stub.cpp` is compiled with the project-wide build flags.

  2. Replaces the `include_directories()` call in `src/CMakeLists.txt` with `target_include_directories()`.

  3. Removes the custom [`WarnAboutGlobalProperties`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/29f7e30d547c30ddb7a637bc3a2dbc7c0e3f5469/cmake/module/WarnAboutGlobalProperties.cmake) module, which is superseded by the new CMake warning.

  ---

  The counterpart for the `secp256k1` repo is https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1996.

  fanquake:
    ACK 435d5b227748a0ac5d6d2887050acf02304576f2 - going to merge this now, given it was mentioned on IRC that devs are seeing local build breakage (after updating CMake).

commit.message:
Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36894: net_processing: set fDisconnect instead of calling DisconnectNode

d63068c58ec9fcc94876bce30865d1a7266d64d4 net_processing: set fDisconnect instead of calling DisconnectNode (Eugene Siegel)

Pull request description:

  `MaybeDiscourageAndDisconnect` calls `DisconnectNode` which creates a `CSubNet` containing only the `CNode`'s address. This will disconnect every `CNode` with the same IP address. This is normally not a problem, except for clearnet-over-tor. If a node has an honest clearnet-over-tor inbound connection, the IP of the inbound peer will be the exit node's IP address. If an attacker connects to the node through the same exit node and sends an invalid message, they can cause every inbound peer sharing the exit node's IP to get disconnected. Fix this by only disconnecting the misbehaving `CNode` rather than every `CNode` sharing the IP.

net_processing: set fDisconnect instead of calling DisconnectNode

MaybeDiscourageAndDisconnect calls DisconnectNode which creates a
CSubNet containing only the CNode's address. This will disconnect
every CNode with the same IP address. This is normally not a problem,
except for clearnet-over-tor. If a node has an honest clearnet-over-tor
inbound connection, the IP of the inbound peer will be the exit node's
IP address. If an attacker connects to the node through the same exit
node and sends an invalid message, they can cause every inbound peer
sharing the exit node's IP to get disconnect. Fix this by only
disconnecting the misbehaving CNode rather than every CNode sharing
the IP.

commit.message:
Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36869: refactor, memusage: Make fields of STL helper structs public

b9a6b0ca51801e95956b7d5307d5b198b9fb7d3f memusage: Make fields of STL helper structs public (Hennadii Stepanov)

Pull request description:

  The `stl_tree_node`, `list_node` and `unordered_node` class templates only mimic the layout of the standard library's container nodes, so that `sizeof` yields an estimate of the memory they use. Their fields are never accessed.

  Since llvm/llvm-project#237374, Clang 24 diagnoses these fields with `-Wunused-private-field`:
  ```console
  $ cmake --build build
  [308/655] Building CXX object src/util/CMakeFiles/bitcoin_util.dir/__/logging.cpp.o
  In file included from ../src/logging.cpp:7:
  ../src/memusage.h:169:11: warning: private field 'ptr_next' is not used [-Wunused-private-field]
    169 |     void* ptr_next;
        |           ^
  ../src/memusage.h:170:11: warning: private field 'ptr_prev' is not used [-Wunused-private-field]
    170 |     void* ptr_prev;
        |           ^
  2 warnings generated.
  [355/655] Building CXX object src/CMakeFiles/bitcoin_node.dir/kernel/disconnected_transactions.cpp.o
  In file included from ../src/kernel/disconnected_transactions.cpp:8:
  In file included from ../src/core_memusage.h:10:
  ../src/memusage.h:184:11: warning: private field 'ptr' is not used [-Wunused-private-field]
  ```

Pull request description:

  Current code uses nullable smart pointers for some stuff that is never null. This is perfectly fine, but a bit confusing:

  * When reading the code, it is not clear which pointer is nullable or never null.
  * Pointers that are never null still have confusing null checks (with possible error handling return branches), which are always dead in coverage reports or when applying mutation testing.
  * While some places have the redundant null checks on pointers that are never null, other places do not, which adds to the confusion.

  Clarify this at compile-time by using `NotNull` (or a plain reference)

commit.message:
scripted-diff: Drop `IWYU pragma: keep` from build config includes

The `bitcoin-build-config.h` header is now marked with
`IWYU pragma: always_keep`, which makes the per-include
`IWYU pragma: keep` comments redundant.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-
OLD='#include <bitcoin-build-config.h> // IWYU pragma: keep'
NEW='#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>'
sed -i "s|$OLD|$NEW|" $(git grep -l "$OLD")

GUARD='#ifndef BITCOIN_CONFIG_H'
PRAGMA='// IWYU pragma: always_keep'
sed -i "s|^$GUARD$|$PRAGMA\n\n&|" cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in
-END VERIFY SCRIPT-

Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36862: test: use long timeout for event waits in interface_ipc_mining

74135e2e625030b18daf7539bd19dabb75948af1 test: use long timeout for event waits in interface_ipc_mining (ViniciusCestarii)

Pull request description:

  Follow-up to #36791, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36791#discussion_r4565761925 by ryanofsky.

  #36791 fixed the `waitTipChanged` timeout on slow hosts, but the `template6` `waitNext` call has the same race: it waits for an event the test triggers after a 0.1s sleep, with a 1s timeout.

  This adds `long_ipc_timeout` and uses it for all waits that end on an event the test triggers.

  To reproduce failure on master:

  ```diff
  diff --git a/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py b/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
  index cdef196fd0..49e1c8a9c1 100755
  --- a/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
  +++ b/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
  @@ -320,7 +320,8 @@ class IPCMiningTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
                   self.log.debug("Wait for another, get one after increase in fees in the mempool")
                   template6 = await wait_and_do(
                       mining_wait_next_template(template5, stack, ctx, waitoptions),
  -                    lambda: self.miniwallet.send_self_transfer(fee_rate=10, from_node=self.nodes[0]))
  +                    lambda: self.miniwallet.send_self_transfer(fee_rate=10, from_node=self.nodes[0]),
  +                    sleep_time=1.2)
                   assert template6 is not None
                   block4 = await mining_get_block(template6, ctx)
                   assert_equal(len(block4.vtx), 3)

  ```

    tACK 74135e2e625030b18daf7539bd19dabb75948af1
  ryanofsky:
    Tested ACK 74135e2e625030b18daf7539bd19dabb75948af1. This finishes the fix from #36791: every wait that returns on an event the test triggers now has at least a minute, so none of them can time out on a slow host with the default timeout factor. I checked that the test passes normally, with the faketime command from #36791, and with `sleep_time=1.2` on the `template6` wait, which failed before.

Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36862: test: use long timeout for event waits in interface_ipc_mining

74135e2e625030b18daf7539bd19dabb75948af1 test: use long timeout for event waits in interface_ipc_mining (ViniciusCestarii)

Pull request description:

  Follow-up to #36791, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36791#discussion_r4565761925 by ryanofsky.

  #36791 fixed the `waitTipChanged` timeout on slow hosts, but the `template6` `waitNext` call has the same race: it waits for an event the test triggers after a 0.1s sleep, with a 1s timeout.

  This adds `long_ipc_timeout` and uses it for all waits that end on an event the test triggers.

  To reproduce failure on master:

  ```diff
  diff --git a/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py b/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
  index cdef196fd0..49e1c8a9c1 100755
  --- a/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
  +++ b/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
  @@ -320,7 +320,8 @@ class IPCMiningTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
                   self.log.debug("Wait for another, get one after increase in fees in the mempool")
                   template6 = await wait_and_do(
                       mining_wait_next_template(template5, stack, ctx, waitoptions),
  -                    lambda: self.miniwallet.send_self_transfer(fee_rate=10, from_node=self.nodes[0]))
  +                    lambda: self.miniwallet.send_self_transfer(fee_rate=10, from_node=self.nodes[0]),
  +                    sleep_time=1.2)
                   assert template6 is not None
                   block4 = await mining_get_block(template6, ctx)
                   assert_equal(len(block4.vtx), 3)

  ```
